pages.text: Each age has two entries: $(thing)the Chronicle$(), the story of that age, and $(thing)Field Notes$(), practical advice. Both open when you reach the age.$(br2)Your $(item)quest book$() has the exact steps. This book is the why; the quest book is the how.

Lost this book? A $(item)book$() and a $(item)flint shard$() make a new one, once you have a crafting table.$(br2)The $(thing)advancements$() button on the front page shows every age you've reached so far.
